lighting: Same neutral key/fill/rim, Filmic, exposure -0.25, 800x800 CPU Cycles 40 samples; no bloom or bodycam post. Morph proofs use the same camera as neutral views.

observations.observed: The uninterrupted oval red ring is replaced by unequal tear widths, contour notches, interrupted narrow fabric-edge sections, four sparse folded fabric tongues and fine closed fray strands. The cavity remains a closed recessed shell; it does not open the original character by itself.

The muscular apex is less needle-like, atrial lumps are smaller/embedded, auricles are thinner/corrugated and two anterior severed arterial lumens face the exterior. Coronary detail remains seated rather than floating.

Robust luminance detail reuses the original generated atlas while suppressing its bright baked color cast. Darker red-brown tissue and sparse mottled wet patches replace uniformly saturated red. Broad studio reflections and soft schematic surface forms remain visible, so this is not a scanned or professional photorealistic organ.

The full GripCompress proof changes the existing organ silhouette asymmetrically rather than scaling the entire mesh. No obviously broken surface or separated coronary branch appears. This is an authored morph, not collision-aware softness or verified finger-pressure contact.

The vessel-lag proof visibly bends the attached distal roots while the neutral bulk stays in place; tissue tension raises/changes the wound lip without exploding its surface. Runtime timing and hand alignment remain unreviewed in this asset task.

remainingLimits: Fictional schematic anatomy, particularly atrial/auricular details, still needs a deeper sculpt or scan pass for professional anatomical fidelity.
Fabric and muscle lips remain smooth authored surfaces; the integration is more irregular but is not a photogrammetric cloth/tissue tear.
Broad soft studio reflections and some mild spherical UV/source-pattern transitions remain visible at close range.
Detail components are individually closed and overlap; they are not one boolean-unioned medical anatomy reconstruction.
Authored compression/lag does not conserve measured tissue volume or solve collision-aware softbody squeezing.
Existing character shader cut mask must fit the irregular local wound silhouette; attachment/socket and moving-hand review belongs to runtime integration.
Bundled Three.js GLTFLoader imports POSITION/NORMAL morphs and ignores TANGENT morph deltas. GLB retains all three for interchange.
qualityVerdict: Visible bounded improvement over v1 in wound irregularity, dark tissue identity, readable torn vessel roots and available local deformation. Accepted for parent runtime integration review with explicit remaining art and physical-simulation limits. Professional photorealism and whole-game AAA quality are not certified.
